usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and AddCal adds a calendar entry with “Create Event” after “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Event” in AddCal
bestTemplate.why: A new product gets its own calendar event with title, start, end and location.

watchOut: “Create Event” needs start and end times, so the product event has to supply or set them.
